text:
alex: Hey @maria @kevin — PTAL on https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3456. I pushed changes that address the shard cleanup race and tuned retry backoff. Short summary below, hoping to merge before end of week if CI is green.

alex: summary: 1) guard null in allocator, 2) deterministic backoff + unit test, 3) added smoke e2e script `scripts/smoke_retries.sh`. Branch: alex/shard-retry-fix (force-pushed). PTAL.

maria: Quick question — did you squash or keep history for this? release prefers preserving commits for bisects.

alex: I squashed once while iterating to simplify review, but can rebase+preserve commits if we want. Right now branch is squashed.

kevin: I can look in ~30m. CI shows failure on linux/memory-test earlier — logs looked like an NPE in allocator. Did your null guard change touch that path?

alex: Good call — the null guard was the change. I added a unit test that covers the allocation path. The failing case was a flaky test on mac, I temporarily skipped that variant and will re-enable after I stabilize it. Local runs are clean.

ci-bot: CI: runtime-linux/memory-test failed at 1798001238 — failing test: test_allocator_free_null (flaky suspected).

maria: If CI rerun is stable, release-ops asks that merges preserve commit history when practical. If you want a fast merge, squash is ok as long as changelog entry is clear. Which do you prefer?

alex: Squash would get this in fastest. If release-ops prefers preserved history I'll rebase+push, but I want to avoid force-pushing during the merge window.

release-ops: release-ops: For this one we slightly prefer preserving commits (helps bisect/rollback), but given the change size we'll accept a squash if you add a detailed changelog. Also: avoid force-pushing between 10:00-12:00 PT during the merge window.

jen: LGTM from me on the code change. Added approval. PTAL @maria @kevin for final thumbs. :thumbsup:

kevin: taking a look now — small nit in the retry config rename (prefer `retry_delay_ms` over `backoff_ms`), leaving a comment.

alex: nit addressed, updated docs and comment. Also added the smoke script mentioned earlier. PTAL.

alex: Target merge: before Friday 10:00 PT. If we go squash, I'll open a follow-up PR to preserve intermediate commits in the changelog/NB.

maria: PTAL now — one tiny doc nit but not blocking. Will approve after CI passes.

ci-bot: CI: rerun started 1798001245

ci-bot: CI: All checks passed 1798001248

release-ops: Merge ops: we'll take this in the 09:30 slot tomorrow if you tag the PR for merge and add `changelog: shard retry fix (JIRA-1234)` to the PR body.

alex: Tagged the PR and added the changelog line. PTAL one last time and thanks everyone!
